name: Liberia (Commonwealth, 1827–1847)
description: Thirteen alternating red and white stripes with a navy canton bearing a white Greek cross.
history: First flag of the colony of Liberia, established by a resolution of the American Colonization Society's colonial government on 9 April 1827: the flag of the United States with a white cross in place of the stars. It was replaced on 24 August 1847, a month after the declaration of independence, by the single-star flag designed by a committee led by Susannah Elizabeth Lewis.
